items.proposed: drop the H3K27M row (alternative eligible diagnosis, not an entry requirement)
items.reason: Inclusion lists several alternative diagnoses ('IDH-wildtype glioblastoma ..., IDH-mutated glioblastoma ..., diffuse astrocytoma ..., diffuse midline glioma H3 K27M mutated'); H3 K27M defines one eligible diagnosis but is not required for entry.

items.proposed: drop the IDH row (both IDH-wildtype and IDH-mutated eligible)
items.reason: Both 'IDH-wildtype glioblastoma' and 'IDH-mutated glioblastoma' are eligible, so IDH status is not an entry requirement; IDH used only to define diagnoses is excluded from any_molecular_selection.
No eligibility or enrichment biomarker remains once the IDH and H3K27M diagnostic-definition rows are dropped.

note: mixed_age (ages 3-30) is set by the script.
